existing_reference: sbl-s0.5 D_design192 original v4 complete cache; verify per-frame source/config/snapshot/input hashes before reuse. Cached baseline is not an additional full run.

comparison_roles.separately_costed_high_reference: m-param-reference explicitly required by M-03, not an additional novel candidate

hyperparameter_tuning: none; all numerical parameters and queries frozen before design

decision.viable_legal_candidate: At complete192-block anchor only: m-soft FER point improvement >=0.05 against B_star and >=0.02 against BOTH deployment classical comparators m-group and m-param-budget; group must converge, while bounded local parameterization is explicitly a budget comparator, not a converged reference. No unaccounted errors or information violations. High-compute reference adequacy must be reported separately. Engineering cost must not already establish infeasibility; n3 timing never grants COST-02 pass. This is an exploratory allocation screen, not confirmation.
decision.classical_solution: If a classical deployable comparator matches or beats m-soft point FER, no novel candidate confirmation; retain recommendation to strengthen baseline, with design uncertainty.
decision.uncertain_or_failed: If screen fails or reference adequacy is unresolved, no adaptive additional anchor samples, no second prototype branch. Record limited/no-go development outcome; do not call lack of significance equivalence.
decision.intervals: Paired wins/losses; simultaneous95% conservative CP four-tail union bounds for six prelisted contrasts. Describe uncertainty separately from point allocation screen.
decision.timing: Engineering same-worker3samples per M arm plus old A2/B_star micro, explicitly cross-run and insufficient. Full development diagnostic time reported but no formal cost pass. Keep Pareto ambiguity; no elimination by unpaired old parallel times.
decision.oracle_gap: Descriptive comparison only: M_link uses truth-derived I and geometry on D_mech; cannot subtract oracle FER across datasets and claim a causal deployability gap.

neighbor_stage.condition: Only viable anchor candidate enters a separately frozen stage; no neighbor data accessed under anchor admission.
neighbor_stage.outline: If all3 required arms retained:160same design blocks x2neighborSNR x3arms=960; would require explicit design-domain amendment and full budget/source freeze first. No promise of failure rerun reserve.

resources.no_blanket_confirmation_fit_claim: Only current stage admitted after source-bound actual engineering evidence. FREEZE-01 must still resolve power, reference arm count, scene precision and remaining resource fit; never reduce required comparators or precision just to fit.
resources.parallelism: one GPU worker with4CPU affinity andBLAS1; compare four M arms in shared shuffled order; avoids concurrent GPU timing noise during current developmental diagnostics

retention: All records and failures retained; no interim FER-driven selection or stopping. Budget/deadline failures are incomplete, not null effects.
